node.title: Re^3: Using eval: $@ isn't returning the error I expect
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It would seem that the "eval" command isn't actually loading the cPanelUserConfig module on the host server. Only the explicit "use" statement seems to work there.

If it's not showing a warning, then it is loading it, but there's a difference: [doc://eval|eval STRING] delays the execution of the [doc://use] until runtime, while normally it would run at compile time. Try adding a BEGIN { ... } block around the whole line, that'll move the execution back into compile time (see [doc://perlmod#BEGIN,-UNITCHECK,-CHECK,-INIT-and-END|BEGIN in perlmod]).
